stem: Which physiological adaptation improves tissue oxygen unloading in chronic anaemia?
explanation: In chronic anaemia, increased red-cell 2,3-diphosphoglycerate lowers haemoglobin oxygen affinity and shifts the oxygen dissociation curve to favour tissue oxygen unloading.
